caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a brass object, which appears to be an ornate andiron or fire dog, used to hold logs in a fireplace. The object is depicted prominently in the foreground, colored in shades of gold and brass, with intricate curves, rounded finials, and a large urn-shaped central post. The base includes decorative cutouts and rests on three small rounded feet. To the left, a partial side view and a front view of the same object are presented in light grey line drawing, without color, serving as technical sketches with proportion lines and a scale beneath them. The background is plain, with a thin rectangular border framing the composition. The artist’s name, Hans Korsch, and the date 1936 are written in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
